content.comment_body: Hello everyone, I'm using a [product_name] [article_no] and have implemented a counter. The functions work as expected, but the count of packages shown on the display can be overwritten if the ESC key is held down for a long time. How can I prevent the displayed count from being edited on the [product_name]? Thanks everyone!

Enable the 'Protection Active' option in the properties of the message text. This will show a notification when the message is displayed and someone presses the ESC key for a long period. Any other parameters that can be changed in the message text will also be blocked if this setting is enabled.

analysis.insight_summary: The user is concerned about accidental overwriting of the package count on a [product_name] device due to long-pressing the ESC key. The current setup permits the counter value to be changed unintentionally. Another user suggests utilizing the 'Protection Active' feature in the message text properties, which prevents modification of displayed values through unintended key presses.
analysis.user_expectations: The user expects a way to safeguard the displayed counter value on the device, making it immune to accidental or unauthorized edits from the interface.
